title: Chat completion response (tailored)
description: Tailored slice of OpenAI's CreateChatCompletionResponse, modeled after https://github.com/openai/openai-openapi (manual_spec branch, openapi.yaml). Strict on the fields the agent loop reads — choices[0].finish_reason, message.content, message.tool_calls.{id,type,function.name,function.arguments} — and permissive on everything else (id, model, created, usage, system_fingerprint, logprobs, index, …) so backends like local llama.cpp can omit them without failing validation. Two intentional divergences from the upstream spec: (1) message.reasoning_content is allowed — Qwen3 / DeepSeek-R1 / llama.cpp emit it on thinking models, but it is not in OpenAI's official schema. (2) function_call is excluded from the finish_reason enum — it is deprecated upstream and unsupported by the parser, so we surface unknown values loudly rather than silently mapping them.

allOf.$comment: Cross-field rule: finish_reason=tool_calls implies message.tool_calls is present and non-empty.
